description: This is a detailed plumbed system diagram showing the bilge and fire system schematic for a marine vessel. It includes a general arrangement view at the top, showing the physical layout of the vessel with various compartments and equipment locations. The bottom half contains the schematic diagram with specific components like pumps, valves, strainers, and piping. Key areas include the lazarette, tender garage, midship sump, engine room sump, mast area sump, ESS enclosure, and sail locker sump. A symbols legend and various tables provide additional details such as pipe details, bill of materials, pump data, pipe legend, drawing specific notes, standard notes, and an approval block.
